summary: Single-repo bug fix in Julia's checked_pow for unsigned integers: the negative-exponent path misidentifies typemax(UInt) as -1 due to wrap-around. Loop quick_fix fits because scope, acceptance criteria, and the one-file change are all stated in the ticket.

steps.why: Convert the ticket into a single implementable story with Given/When/Then AC and tech notes for the fix.
steps.instructions: Focus on the unsigned wrap-around logic in power_by_squaring's negative-exponent path in base/intfuncs.jl. The fix must preserve signed -1 behavior and only affect unsigned typemax rejection.

steps.why: Cross-check that the story's acceptance criteria match the ticket and that the fix scope excludes signed integers, Bool, BigInt, floats, and all paths outside base/intfuncs.jl and test/math.jl.
Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.

skipped.why: Scope and acceptance criteria are concrete and fully specified in the ticket; no product sign-off needed for an internal math bug.
The ticket already identifies the file, function, and root cause (unsigned wrap in isone(-x) check); no low-level design step needed.
The ticket lists exact test cases and the existing test file; no separate test design artifact needed.
